patches_applied.issue: VERIFIED NUMERICAL ERROR: '395,009 multisets' was quoted against orders <=60. 395,009 is the <=55 count; <=60 gives 557,844. The x2 scaled pair contains an order-60 cone and cannot appear in a <=55 scan.

patches_applied.issue: HIGHEST-VALUE FINDING. K(F) is defined up to isometry. For n>=4 the Teichmuller space of a sphere with n cone points has dimension 2n-6>0, and every heat coefficient depends only on the cone orders, so a whole family shares all coefficients. K is infinite for n>=4 and Remark 5.6's 'K<=n extends Theorem C' fails.
patches_applied.action: Added a boxed correction; restated the n=4 result as cone-order-multiset determinacy; flagged as a defect in the manuscript, item 18.

patches_applied.issue: 'Leading term known in closed form' was answered with a three-value pattern rather than a formula.
patches_applied.action: Added leading coeff = |B_{2l+2}|/(2(l+1)!(2l+1)), verified at l=0..3 against direct evaluation and extended to l=6; non-vanishing by von Staudt-Clausen, which is the general-n mechanism.
